versions.notes: Adds stacked focus-aware notifications with configurable timeout, persistent MQTT topic discovery, and optional Frigate review routing to tvnotify/notify.
Older channel releases can be saved to Downloads/HouseControl TVNotify without installing; the app reports the saved location.
Adds channel-scoped APK version selection; selected releases are revalidated before download, and canceled updates are cleaned up.

INTERNAL TEST ONLY — debug-signed build for validating the dev updater installer flow; includes the fix to close the staged APK stream before session commit. Not a production release. Android can update this build only when the installed app has the same signing certificate.

INTERNAL TEST ONLY — debug-signed APK for validating the dev updater feed. Not a production release. Android will accept this update only when the installed app has the same signing certificate as this local debug build; a production-signed install with a different certificate cannot be updated in place.
